Summary of Kimi Performance on HW6

I tested Kimi AI’s ability to solve problems from hw6 focusing on GNN architectures. 

Overall, Kimi demonstrated strong reasoning capability across most questions. It correctly handled:

Linear algebraic interpretations of GNN message passing

Inductive proofs involving adjacency matrix powers

Identification of valid permutation-invariant update rules

Loss computation using masked training nodes

Interpretation of max aggregation

Analysis of computational scaling in GraphNet architectures

For these, Kimi’s reasoning was correct and aligned with the solutions.

Weaknesses

Tends to produce over-engineered answers when a simpler one is expected

Occasionally misidentifies structural details (e.g., graph neighbors)

Does not always verify provided diagrams or datasets before proceeding


The following LaTeX document compiles and evaluates Kimi’s responses from the linked chat session. 

Click the link to view conversation: https://www.kimi.com/share/19aed915-2932-8b91-8000-0000bdfd7ac0
